# Driver Shift Rules

Version: 3
Effective: 1 January 2025
Issued by: Transit Agency, Operations Office

## Rules
- Maximum shift length: 9 hours, including a 45-minute break after 4.5 hours of driving.
- Minimum rest between two shifts: 11 hours.
- Maximum consecutive working days: 5.
- Night shifts (between 22:00 and 05:00) receive a 20% pay allowance.
